author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.18.1 — Fixes a bug in 1.18.0's own fix: mode:0 ("Idle", the vacuum's actual real-world state) was being extracted with `heartBeat?.mode ?: eventFlag?.mode`, and Groovy Truth treats 0 as falsy, so a genuine mode:0 was discarded and fell through to eventFlag.mode (which doesn't exist), landing on the 1.17.1 "no mode" warning for perfectly valid data -- confirmed live, firing on every single poll while idle. Replaced with explicit null checks. Verified against the actual live payload shape.
